in_sanskrit.name: श्रीराम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: श्री (Shri) - prosperity, wealth, abundance, riches, opulence, splendor, wealthiness, prosperousness, richness, virtue, auspiciousness, excellence, beauty, good fortune, welfare, happiness, good luck, success, abundance, wealth, and Rama (Rama) - a prince, a man, a hero, a lover, a husband, a warrior, a king, a protector

in_hindi.name: श्रीराम
in_hindi.meaning: श्री (Shri) - प्रसाद (prasad) - grace, mercy, favor, blessedness, happiness, prosperity, wealth, good fortune, and राम (Ram) - राजा (raja) - king, ruler, monarch, sovereign, and आदम (Adam) - man, human, mortal, earthly, terrestrial

in_tamil.name: ஶ்ரீராம்
in_tamil.meaning: ஶ்ரீ (Shri) - அவிர்பாவம் (avirbavam) - wealth, prosperity, abundance, richness, opulence, splendor, and ராம் (Ram) - அவர் (avar) - that one, he, and மனவன் (manavan) - man

in_telugu.name: శ్రీరామ్
in_telugu.meaning: శ్రీ (Shri) - ప్రసాదము (prasadamu) - grace, mercy, favor, blessedness, happiness, prosperity, wealth, good fortune, and రామ్ (Ram) - యేశు (Yesu) - జీవీ (Jivu) - living being, and మానవేషు (manaveshu) - among humans

in_marathi.name: Sriram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wealth and Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sriram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sri: Goddess of Wealth and Fortune, Rama: Ruler of the People

in_bengali.name: Sriram
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Wealth and Prosperity
